description: This file defines the NormalizeRecords class, which extends BatchJob and is responsible for normalizing string fields in database records across multiple modules within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for running normalization processes, managing configuration settings, processing record chunks, and interacting with database records based on date ranges.

classes.name: NormalizeRecords
classes.description: A class extending BatchJob responsible for normalizing string fields in database records across multiple modules, managing process state, configuration, and database interactions.

methods.name: runAll
methods.description: Executes the full normalization process on applicable modules, managing process status, chunking, and timing, and returning success status with messages.

methods.name: getJobKey
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the background job, 'utf-normalize'.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes environment settings, including language and user context.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines if the normalization job should execute, updates job status, and sets execution mode.

methods.name: getRepairStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current repair status from configuration.

methods.name: setRepairStatus
methods.description: Sets the repair status in configuration.

methods.name: getExecutionMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current execution mode setting.

methods.name: setExecutionMode
methods.description: Sets the execution mode setting.

methods.name: isValidRepairFrom
methods.description: Validates the 'repair_from' date string.

methods.name: getConfigEntry
methods.description: Fetches a configuration setting value for the given key.

methods.name: setConfigEntry
methods.description: Saves a configuration setting value for the given key.

methods.name: setupTracking
methods.description: Prepares a list of modules to process, excluding certain core modules.

methods.name: getAllIdsInRange
methods.description: Retrieves all record IDs in a specified date range for a given module.

methods.name: repairChunk
methods.description: Processes a chunk of records for normalization, updating fields and counting normalized records.

methods.name: repairStringValues
methods.description: Normalizes specific string fields in a record row.

methods.name: getRepairableFieldNames
methods.description: Builds a list of text fields in a bean that require normalization.

methods.name: getRecordChunk
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of records from the database given their IDs.

methods.name: debugLog
methods.description: Writes debug messages to the log.

methods.name: echoOutput
methods.description: Outputs messages conditionally, flushing the output buffer.

methods.name: getModulesToNormalize
methods.description: Returns a list of modules to process, merging global module list with excluded modules.
